usage: Held-out set. Written before any evaluation on it and frozen: the router prompt and validation rules must not be tuned against these cases. Report the first run as the baseline; later runs after changes are regression results.
authorship: Written by the same author as the router prompt, without copying prompt examples. A set written by an independent person would be a stronger test.
label_rules: intent follows what the user wants, even if information is missing.
status is routed only when the request can be executed as written.
An order number must appear in the DEMO-<digits> form (any letter case); other forms such as '1001' or '订单1001' need clarification.
knowledge_only is routed only when exactly one device model, hardware version and sales region are given; region may be written as US, us or 美版.
A request to submit a ticket directly is still an order_ticket intent; submission itself always requires separate approval.
